title: butteryCoin
tagline: DeFi dashboard with full 1inch API integration: swap, history, balances, prices & more.
description: This project is a full-stack decentralized finance (DeFi) dashboard built to showcase the extensive capabilities of the 1inch API ecosystem. It allows users to seamlessly interact with multiple DeFi features in one place, including real-time wallet tracking, token swapping (classic and intent-based), viewing historical transaction data, and accessing up-to-date token prices and metadata — all powered by 1inch’s robust suite of APIs.
how_its_made:
This project is a full-stack DeFi dashboard built using Next.js for both frontend and backend logic, combined with 1inch’s powerful REST APIs. It integrates various 1inch services including wallet transaction history, token swaps, real-time token data, and intent-based Fusion+ swaps.

The project showcases how to build a production-ready dApp using modern tools like Next.js, serverless API routes, environment variable handling, and secure API proxying — while deeply integrating multiple 1inch DeFi features.
